nested_cross_fitting.selection_objective: minimum mean inner-fold IPCW Brier at 730.5 days
nested_cross_fitting.pooled_metric_censoring_estimator: full eligible development cohort at evaluation only; predictions remain OOF

calibration_definition.censoring_adjustment: training-derived inverse probability of censoring weights
calibration_definition.in_the_large: weighted logistic intercept with predicted logit risk as fixed offset
calibration_definition.slope: weighted logistic coefficient multiplying predicted logit risk

limitations: Results are post-lock exploratory because prior Phase 6 outcomes had already been seen.
Repeated OOF estimates are internal development estimates, not external validation.
Pattern metrics below the frozen n/event support gate are descriptive only.
V0 evaluates only the safety anchor and cannot establish fusion or routing benefit.
